summary.value: The demo project behind my Image Optimizer webinar: CKEditor 5 with the Uploadcare-powered image workflow - upload, transform, and deliver optimized images without leaving the editor.

content.value:
What's inside

A runnable CKEditor 5 project with the Uploadcare integration configured: image upload from devices, URLs, and cloud services, plus on-the-fly transformations and optimized delivery. It is the exact setup I walked through in the \"Streamline Your Image Workflow\" webinar.
